criteria.description: The exported NostrClient class and custom socket/reconnect/message-queue implementation are removed from client.js.
criteria.verification: Static inspection: no NostrClient export, sockets Map, handleMessage, notifyRelay*, reissueSubscriptions, custom reconnect timers, or rejectPendingPublishesForRelay remain in client.js.

criteria.description: All browser relay connections are mediated by nostr-tools SimplePool through a thin pool wrapper.
criteria.verification: pool.js constructs SimplePool({ enableReconnect: true }) and uses ensureRelay/relay.subscribe/pool.publish/pool.close/pool.destroy for connection, subscription, publish, and cleanup paths.

criteria.description: Existing nostr singleton API remains usable by stores and helpers.
criteria.verification: controlplane, controlplane request, encrypted request, DNS, assistant, and soul helper tests import client.js and exercise connect/subscribe/queryUntilEose/query/publish compatible behavior.

criteria.description: EOSE-authoritative query behavior, CLOSED/abort/timeout fail-closed behavior, inbound validation, event dedupe, AUTH notification, and subscription cleanup are deterministic and tested.
criteria.verification: sanity.test.js and nostr-client-parsing.test.js cover validator rejection, frame ordering, multi-relay EOSE, timeout/abort, CLOSED incomplete errors, publish OK mapping, AUTH callback forwarding, and disconnect subscription cleanup.

criteria.description: Existing web unit tests and production build pass after the replacement.
criteria.verification: npm run test:unit passes 54 files / 496 tests; npm run build exits 0.
